 1          Plaintiff DR. ANDREI GAFITA (“Gafita”), Defendant NUCS AI, INC. (“Nucs AI”), and
 2 Defendant NIJAT AHMADOV (collectively, the “Parties”), by and through their respective counsel of
 3 record, stipulate and agree to extend the time for Mr. Ahmadov to answer or otherwise respond to Gafita’s
 4 Complaint pursuant to Civil Local Rule 6-1(a) as follows:
 5          1.      On December 17, 2025, Gafita commenced this action by filing a complaint in the above-
 6 captioned matter in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California.
 7          2.      On March 27, 2026, Gafita served the complaint on Mr. Ahmadov.
 8          3.      Mr. Ahmadov’s current deadline to answer or otherwise respond to the complaint is April
 9 17, 2026.
10          4.      There have been no prior requests for extensions submitted to the Court by Mr. Ahmadov.
11          5.      Nucs AI’s motion to dismiss is pending and set to be heard on May 8, 2026.
12          6.      This extension will not alter the date of any event or any deadline already fixed by Court
13 order.
14          7.      The Parties hereby stipulate and agree that Mr. Ahmadov’s deadline to answer, move, or
15 otherwise respond to the complaint shall be the same deadline as Nucs AI’s after the Court rules on Nucs
16 AI’s pending motion to dismiss.
17
18          IT IS SO STIPULATED.

                                  1          WHEREAS, Defendant Nucs AI filed its Motion to Dismiss on March 6, 2026 [Dkt. 17];

                                  2          WHEREAS, Plaintiff Dr. Andrei Gafita filed his Opposition to the Motion to Dismiss

                                  3   on March 12, 2026 [Dkt. 22];

                                  4          WHEREAS, Plaintiff subsequently realized that he had inadvertently prepared and filed

                                  5   an Opposition that complies with the page limits and formatting requirements of the Northern

                                  6   District of California Local Rules but fails to comply with the requirements of the Court’s

                                  7   Standing Order;

                                  8          WHEREAS, Plaintiff is willing to file a corrected brief that conforms with the Court’s

                                  9   Standing Order;

                                 10          WHEREAS, the parties recognize that requiring Defendant to respond to a noncompliant

                                 11   brief imposes additional burdens on Defendant, which the parties desire to avoid;

                                 17              filing of Plaintiff’s corrected Opposition;

                                 18          3. Plaintiff’s corrected Opposition shall not make any substantive additions or new

                                 19              legal arguments that were not in its original Opposition;

                                 20          4. In the event the Court declines to require Plaintiff to file a corrected Opposition, the

                                 21              deadline for Defendant to serve its Reply shall be 7 days from entry of and/or denial
